rule: This ledger is the factory. New incidents add rows. Files in pack/CORE encode a subset. Do not grow by importing the mill.
source_note: Extracted from poketcg playbook, EVAL_PROTOCOL, DEAD-ENDS, START-HERE field facts, Bonkers LAWS, DOC-ROLES, ARCHIVE-POLICY, TOOLS.md, METRICS, COST, AUTONOMY/GATES/GRAPH templates, qol-baseline.

rows.name: Git is the only control plane.
rows.detail: Claim by push, dispatch by inbox-on-main, report on status branches. Authenticity, locking, audit, crash recovery come free.
rows.earned_by: Clipboard courier; inbox forgery; hub checkout hijack

rows.name: The repo is the memory.
rows.detail: Sessions die constantly. State in artifacts, not context windows. Successor re-orients in minutes.
rows.earned_by: Three lead-session deaths in three days

rows.name: START-HERE contains no sentence a later sentence corrects.
rows.detail: Historical contradiction lives in provenance files. Checker wins.
rows.earned_by: 66 files still citing a retracted figure; AGENTS.md as 500-line supersede stack

rows.name: Correct by editing; retract by ledger.
rows.detail: Grep finds the wrong answer first if you append-only-correct.

rows.name: Never delete documentation.
rows.detail: Archive banner + supersession register. Missing files look like "n=0 / never done."
rows.encode: CANDIDATE (conflict: Bonkers overwrites *current* truth; archive research)

rows.name: Wake pack, not the novel.
rows.detail: Inventories + NOW + CURRENT-TRUTH. Do not open 600 research files on wake.
rows.earned_by: Harness accessibility; 44% of PRs were markdown-only

rows.name: Governance is origin/main, not the hub working copy.
No shallow git in the hub.
rows.detail: Shallow fetch destroyed merge-base, stranded 15h of read-side.

rows.name: Dates cite their source artifact or are void.
rows.detail: Derived ceilings are not walls.
rows.earned_by: DATES.md D4 wrongly propagated as a schedule

rows.name: Handoffs shrink over time.
rows.detail: That trend is the health metric.

rows.name: Path-exists inventories beat hand maps for existence; a CURRENT file beats inventories for meaning.
rows.earned_by: HARNESS_MAP product story went stale while paths were fine

rows.name: Forward slashes in every manifest on every OS.
Freeze the bar before the run.
rows.detail: Gate = pre-result commit on the shared remote. Self-asserted timestamps are unverifiable.

rows.name: One failed frozen criterion banks the negative.
rows.detail: No repair cycle, no post-hoc threshold. Amendments only pre-result.
rows.earned_by: "#819 pending full matrix" already failed ≥6 criteria

rows.name: Exactly one machine-readable verdict token.
rows.detail: Hedge prose is not a verdict.

rows.name: Author XOR verifier.
rows.detail: Positives and first-use instruments need non-author reproduction. Negatives bank author-only same-cycle. Extended even to *hardware*: the box that built it never issues its verdict.

rows.name: Sabotage before trust.
rows.detail: A guard is decorative until it fails the defect it claims to catch. Fresh fixtures, never the author's tests.
rows.earned_by: `0*64` hash gate; screen harness testing the wrong agent; PREFLIGHT PASSED with 14/23 skipped

rows.name: Measure the deployed artifact, not the repo.
rows.earned_by: Kaggle bundle silently played skip-bot while local evals looked fine (E016/E022); 133 deck files → 26 lists
rows.encode: CORE: Law 3; rebuild preflight per runtime

rows.name: CI-green ≠ gate-green ≠ admitted.
rows.detail: Compare number *and shape* to the frozen row before "pending/trending."

rows.name: A number in a report is backed by an artifact committed in the same change.
rows.detail: Disk, worktree, and bus comments are not evidence.

rows.name: No arm is spoken about before its matched control exists.
rows.detail: An n=20 look is not a result.
rows.earned_by: "940 kernel wins at 85%" reversed at n=300

rows.name: Equation-bearing claims get arithmetic recompute
rows.detail: (units, denominators, freeze/maturity, one parameter model, ref/archive/sha joins). Clean diff cannot catch a cross-family join.
rows.earned_by: Four contaminated PRs in a day

rows.name: Register discipline: append corrections; never rewrite banked history.
rows.detail: Original claim + error mechanism stay visible.

rows.name: Default disposition: NOT promotion-eligible
rows.detail: until author + independent verify + scope + power.

rows.name: Reads are advisory the moment data exists; only SPENDS wait for confirmation.
A HOLD whose premise is withdrawn does not bind.
rows.detail: Silence is not a veto.

rows.name: Per-seat LATEST verdict at the exact head governs.
rows.detail: Older PASSes on moved heads are void.

rows.name: Merging command re-reads full verdict set + head in one command.
rows.detail: Sample-then-merge is a defect.
rows.earned_by: #1980 trio complete while merge prose claimed HOLD

rows.name: Bank a binding change BEFORE the verifier polls.
Delivery is claimed only after reading the artifact back from the consumer's surface.
rows.detail: A write landing is not delivery.

rows.name: Every byte a verifier reads is identity-bound
rows.detail: (bound path + sha before parse).

rows.name: Suspect leakage FIRST on any surprise positive.
Transcribe, don't paraphrase, when folding findings into pre-regs.
Pre-register families/sweeps, not single configs, when iteration is expected.
PREREG-CHECKLIST from YOUR refusals
rows.detail: , numbered, self-attested. Do not copy another project's refusal list.

rows.name: Local eval is a filter, not a predictor
rows.detail: until a live calibration exists.

rows.name: Power the instrument for the effect you care about.
rows.detail: Underpowered "null" is UNKNOWN, not refuted. +5–8pp claims need N that actually has power (here: ≥1200/arm; N=400 ~40% power at +6pp).
rows.earned_by: MDE 9.84pp at n=400 vs protocol needing 5–8pp

rows.name: Cite the powered study, not the smoke.
rows.detail: n=20 "20-0" was labeled directional in its own source; the load-bearing result was N=100.

rows.name: Reachable ≠ selected ≠ executed.
rows.detail: Search body unreachable; policy branch never taken; 12/16 switches OFF in the shipped bundle. Ask which agent and demand the sha.

rows.name: Age-in-hours does not catch a frozen arm.
rows.detail: Need froze_at + matured. Pull poll history, never just the value.

rows.name: Pair-mean, not winner's curse.
rows.detail: Quoting the better copy of two is forbidden.

rows.name: Do not quote a point bar when the estimate is n=2–3.
rows.detail: Publish an interval.

rows.name: A path you cannot read is not a path that is empty.
rows.detail: Name the box.
rows.earned_by: False "n=0, closed" from the other machine

rows.name: Self-similarity is not an opponent.
rows.detail: Scoring 97–99% against your own heuristic piloting their decks is not a field result.

rows.name: The ship path must carry the logic.
rows.detail: A knob experiment on a module the loader never imports is measuring a ghost. Config/env/flag that the deployed object cannot see does not exist.
rows.earned_by: rules_lucario knobs vs fielded single file; lazy imports stripped post-init

rows.name: Vacuous counters.
rows.detail: An eager-default seam that bumps on every call is not evidence the candidate ran. Require verify() AND a nonzero *candidate* hook-resolution counter.

rows.name: Skipped checks are not a pass.
rows.detail: Print how many checks actually ran.

rows.name: If the environment exposes no seed, seed-paired eval is impossible.
rows.detail: Don't pretend pairing. Throughput is the variance lever.

rows.name: A flat pooled score can hide the band that matters.
rows.detail: FarmScore vs EliteFloor; harmonic mean so one easy band cannot hide a transition weakness.
rows.earned_by: Leaders farm the field and survive peers

rows.name: Latency claims only from the mode that can support them.
rows.detail: Parallel runner outputs are WR-only.

rows.name: Config overrides go through one API, then assert they landed.
rows.detail: Direct mutation of a module that can load twice is a silent no-op.
rows.earned_by: #96: 2,400 games on the default while claiming otherwise

rows.name: Dead-end rows carry a SCOPE GUARD:
rows.detail: what the evidence supports AND what it does not. Overstating a negative is the more expensive failure because it is invisible.
rows.earned_by: DEAD-ENDS.md purpose statement; A6 VOID almost closed the live lane

rows.name: Arithmetic can close a door independently of cell count.
rows.detail: Teacher μ below the wall means perfect imitation still loses; six failed cells were corroboration, not the ruling.

rows.name: Agreement-with-champion is ceilinged at reproducing the champion.
rows.detail: It can never demonstrate improvement *on* it.

rows.name: "It imported" is not "it ran."
rows.detail: Symbols present, engagement vacuous, then 24-0 to its own fallback.

rows.name: Artifact identity chain:
rows.detail: code hash, data hash, config, experiment id, in every result file.

rows.name: Phased investigation:
rows.detail: frame → investigate → assumption registry → roadmap → phase loop. PLAN.md is state. Gates are approve/adjust, not approve/reject.

rows.name: Existence-check before building.
rows.detail: Research whether the thing exists.

rows.name: Incident → rule → machine check, within one cycle.
rows.earned_by: Playbook empirical claim (encode-recurrence still unverified as a *statistic*; encoding remains the cheap default)

rows.name: Rule diet.
rows.detail: Incidents add a check or a checklist line, never a new prose rule. Prose gets compiled and retired.
rows.earned_by: Ceremony pathology: lots of experiments/cards/tools → few submissions

rows.name: Additions require a named incident.
rows.detail: No speculative structure. 646-tool sprawl is the anti-pattern.

rows.name: Pivot-check when a load-bearing assumption flips.
rows.detail: Do not absorb silently.

rows.name: Official scoring is the rubric.
rows.detail: Do not invent a 14/14/14 split or a Second-Round/BO3 prize.

rows.name: One north-star, then an answer map
rows.detail: (claims as a graph: requires / tests / supports / refutes / unlocks). Optional; not default factory.

rows.name: Control vs treatment identity.
rows.detail: Public baseline is a control, not the mission win. Ask which object.
rows.earned_by: OWNED-CORE vs public c61; two agents

rows.name: Process judgment, not domain expertise, is the human's job.
rows.detail: Persistence, irreversibles, priority. The team learns the domain from sources and measurement.

rows.name: Genuinely different perspectives are load-bearing.
rows.detail: Adversarial second opinions; different model families that disagree usefully.

rows.name: The learning loop is the product.
rows.detail: Week two runs on autopilot where week one ran on paste *because of the ledger*.

rows.name: It is teachable because it is written down.
rows.detail: Join, roster, idle behavior, orders, what counts as true, why each rule exists — an afternoon.

rows.name: SOTA wins by default against calcified scar tissue.
rows.detail: A finding must earn its place against current evidence.

rows.name: Minimum viable subset:
rows.detail: solo operator + two agents yields the headline properties at roughly a fifth of the tooling. Default one strong agent; fleet is opt-in.

rows.name: Humans gate irreversibles only
rows.detail: (spend, publication, deletion, production, scope). Everything else: proceed, leave receipts. Asking permission for reversible in-scope work is a contract violation.
rows.earned_by: TheHolyGrail died at "register the GitHub App"; The Village GATE PENDING a month

rows.name: An OPEN gate older than its SLA is an incident.
rows.detail: Waiting on the human is the #1 documented project killer.

rows.name: STOP table is tiny; everything else is LOG-AND-CONTINUE.
rows.detail: "If clearance doesn't check it, it cannot block."

rows.name: Staging ladder: autonomy proportional to reversibility.
rows.detail: Zero-key scratch → one-key candidacy → two-key promotion → Principal-key ship.

rows.name: Error budgets loosen when healthy.
rows.detail: Governance is not a one-way ratchet.

rows.name: Rigor lives at promotion boundaries; construction runs free.
rows.earned_by: Proven +15.2pp artifact sat 5–6 days unshipped; 4 zero-submission days

rows.name: Two-strike parks the LANE, never the box.
rows.detail: Fall through to the next runway item.
rows.earned_by: Fleet-wide idle over one blocked lane

rows.name: "Awaiting adjudication" is not a legal idle
rows.detail: while a pre-authorized runway exists.

rows.name: The Principal is never the courier.
rows.detail: One aggregated 🔔 block per cycle.

rows.name: Escalation tiers.
rows.detail: SEV0 pages the human; SEV1 lead; SEV2 batched advisor. Nothing else pages.

rows.name: Ask the team where it hurts
rows.detail: before buying compute or adding process.
rows.earned_by: Jul-16 interviews: coordination, not compute, was the constraint

rows.name: Worker dissent has standing.
rows.detail: Less-privileged alternative can win.
rows.earned_by: Roach objected to SSH elevation; watchdog without new privileges won

rows.name: Claim-by-push; branch existence is the lock.
rows.detail: Alphabetically-first wins ties; post-work collisions ruled by pushed evidence.

rows.name: Files owned is the mutex.
rows.detail: Two live cards, same file = ERROR.

rows.name: One persistent worktree per handle.
rows.detail: New card = branch switch, not a new folder. Never checkout the hub.

rows.name: Idle is illegal. Flywheel = default job that never waits on another box.
Producer owns the bridge.
rows.detail: DONE = consumer's exact filename, sha-verified, on the watched surface, + ledger row. Broker put is not delivery.
rows.earned_by: Both directions of a cross-box transfer stalled

rows.name: 15-minute handoff SLA
rows.detail: on every declared edge, including the lead's merge queue.
rows.earned_by: Stall forensics: lead review + one unowned handoff were the only bottlenecks

rows.name: Dual-trigger wake:
rows.detail: own-inbox SHA diff + ≤30 min time baseline. Events for speed, time for worst case; each covers the other's death. Firing on every main push is a spend leak.
rows.earned_by: Misty over-wake; time-only loop hour-scale latency + two false dead-watchers

rows.name: Waits are fields, not prose.
rows.detail: `blocked_on="<target>: <what>"`. `bg:` for parked secondary waits.
rows.earned_by: 45-min wait on an already-merged PR, invisible to every detector

rows.name: Stale-order rule:
rows.detail: on any wake, consume the ENTIRE inbox backlog. Later entries supersede.
rows.earned_by: Agent ran a superseded screen for hours

rows.name: Unblock-notify:
rows.detail: when a blocker clears, write the waiting agent an inbox entry the same cycle.
rows.earned_by: Ash and Brock sat silent on cleared blockers

rows.name: Cadence:
rows.detail: event-driven; chain every already-authorized step in one wake. Fixed intervals are fallbacks only.

rows.name: VALUE-delta, not ACTIVITY-delta.
rows.detail: WORKING + zero value progress >2h = STALLED. Freshness of a PID is not health.
rows.earned_by: Harvest 0 eps for 11h as WORKING; dry harvest's activity counter defeated the flag
rows.encode: CORE: Law 8 spirit; encode in heartbeats

rows.name: Silence is an event.
rows.detail: Stale WORKING heartbeat is not "fine."

rows.name: Remove the router from the loop.
rows.detail: Repeating routing pattern → standing order. Standing re-verify, class-token self-engage, movement audit. Agents cheap/parallel; lead attention serial.
rows.earned_by: 2026-07-18 movement wave; three finished items queued on routing

rows.name: TO:-header delivery.
rows.detail: Mid-body mentions are not delivery.

rows.name: Attribution is seat:field, not GitHub identity.
rows.detail: Same identity posts for every harness.

rows.name: Liveness is three-state:
rows.detail: advancing output, answered nonce, or lawfully-quiet (do not escalate as dead).

rows.name: O(1) backlog:
rows.detail: assign the top unassigned item only to an idle seat with empty queue.

rows.name: main is lead-write-only.
rows.detail: Inbox authenticity is structural.
rows.earned_by: Agent wrote another's inbox claiming Jon approved

rows.name: Identity fixed, function fluid.
rows.detail: Names never change; functions re-sort around competence; org formalizes the re-sort.

rows.name: Repair worktrees BEFORE prune; KEEP ambiguous.
Watchers live OUTSIDE git worktrees.
rows.detail: Branch checkouts clobber in-tree watchers.

rows.name: Dual-channel box liveness
rows.detail: (git + beacon). Git-silent+beacon-alive = CHANNEL_ISSUE, not BOX_OFFLINE.

rows.name: Support lanes when the queue is empty
rows.detail: (research / investigate / propose / verify). Never idle, never invent scope.

rows.name: Commit author is the handle
rows.detail: , per-command, never via shared git config.

rows.name: Orient before acting.
rows.detail: Never on remembered state.
rows.earned_by: Session blocked on a blocker resolved 12h earlier

rows.name: OS scheduler, not a model session,
rows.detail: for digest and courier. Overnight work cannot depend on a chat being open.

rows.name: Dispatch ledger
rows.detail: recovers orders lost to crashes.
rows.earned_by: Windows update killed a dispatch in flight

rows.name: Deadlines file survives lead-session death.
rows.detail: New session re-arms from the file.

rows.name: LEAD-STATE pane
rows.detail: a successor lead resumes from. Do not trust older memos.

rows.name: Queue worker: fail-closed admission, caps, PARK on failure.
rows.detail: Authorization is declared state, not a cryptographic signature. Irreversible-shaped argv refused.

rows.name: Long jobs: observable heartbeat AND incremental atomic checkpoint.
rows.detail: When blind to progress, check the checkpoint — don't kill.

rows.name: Spend buys closed loops, and it is always metered.
rows.detail: Stale meter is a failure. Dollar figures from tokens are API-list-equivalent, never cash.
rows.earned_by: Evidence culture that exempted its own cost; COST.md empty checkboxes. *The specific dollar figure in Law 9 is unverified — keep the idea, not the number.*

rows.name: Throughput is not progress.
rows.detail: Commits, PRs, tools, documents are activity. Progress = hypothesis → pre-registered test → verified result → decision.
rows.earned_by: 2,199 PRs with zero closed experiment loops for 24 days; 30-day fleet, zero confirmed improvements

rows.name: Ceremony ratio
rows.detail: (governance:construction) as a dashboard number.

rows.name: Wake efficiency.
rows.detail: Over-waking is a direct spend leak.

rows.name: Model turns on courier/heartbeat work that a shell could do → ~0.
Tier-match mechanical lanes.
rows.detail: Verifier reproductions of mechanical claims do not need frontier models.

rows.name: GPU duty cycle while everyone reports busy
rows.detail: is a diagnostic.

rows.name: Banked→shipped latency
rows.detail: is the number that caught the 5–6 day stall of a proven artifact.

rows.name: Forecast every dispatch; grade actual on the receipt.
rows.detail: Calibration flywheel.

rows.name: stdlib-only where the artifact ships.
rows.detail: Reviewable, no hidden deps.

rows.name: Exit codes are the API.
rows.detail: Everything gates on everything else.

rows.name: Fail closed, loudly.
rows.detail: Cannot measure ⇒ failure, never silence. "SKIPPED — not reporting clean."

rows.name: Each check cites its incident in-source.
rows.detail: Tools are the fossil record.

rows.name: Ambiguity resolves to KEEP or PARK, never proceed.
QoL baseline for unattended jobs:
rows.detail: dry-run, idempotency, checkpoints, resume, timeouts, structured logs, cancellation, machine-readable output. Scale to project size; N/A is a valid verdict.

rows.name: Non-destructive install.
rows.detail: Transplant refuses differing targets; identity files are never overwritten.

rows.name: Capability / switch manifest
rows.detail: for any product with dormant paths. Which switches are ON in the *shipped* object.

rows.name: The mill.
rows.detail: Hundreds of domain scripts are the waste product of discovery, not the factory.
